title: 第14章 山间训练第15章 出发
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 后山训练场，观世宗七人齐聚。
“你们先互相了解一下各自的专长。”
叶知秋作为宗主主持道，“你们先把自己的常用招式亮出来，我和你们师尊看看。”
后山训练场上，四道身影如游龙般穿梭交错，剑光闪烁间，金石交击之声不绝于耳。
“小晏，左翼慢了三分！”
封无痕负手立于场边，锐利的目光紧盯着场中比剑的四人，“小白，你的招式也太过花哨，信不信你还没出招，你就被对手踹下台了！”
话音刚落，只听。
欧阳叙白被柳清晏一剑挑飞，狼狈地在地上滚了两圈才停下。
他灰头土脸地爬起来，哭丧着脸道：“晏哥，你下手也太狠了吧！”
柳清晏收剑而立，面无表情：“你要不要想想你一个金丹初期的被我一个筑基大圆满的打飞，丢不丢人。”
“就是就是，”
柳清漪在一旁幸灾乐祸，“小白你刚才那双剑耍得跟蝴蝶似的，可惜中看不中用～”
楚安芷站在场边，看着弟子们互相切磋，嘴角不自觉扬起笑意。
她转头看向身旁练了一会，说自己一晚没休息好，跑过来躲懒的赵归涯，笑容一垮：“看看人家，再看看你。”
赵归涯正倚在一棵树干上嗑瓜子，闻言懒洋洋地伸了个懒腰：“师尊～昨天灵力透支还没恢复呢～在说了我可不想拿着我的基础剑跟他们本命剑的打。”
楚安芷正要训斥这个偷懒的徒弟，突然发现赵归涯虽然嘴上说着不练，但那双琥珀色的眼睛却始终紧盯着场中每个人的动作，时不时还微微点头或摇头。
“你倒是看得挺认真。”
楚安芷挑眉道。
赵归涯咽下瓜子仁，懒洋洋地说：“师尊，你觉得小白的剑法怎么样？”
楚安芷闻言重新看向场中。
欧阳叙白此时正与柳清漪对练，双剑舞得密不透风，确实华丽非常。
“花哨有余，实用不足。”
楚安芷评价道。
“不仅如此。”
赵归涯突然站直身体，手指轻点，“你看他右肩每次出剑前都会不自觉地抬高三分，我堂姐夫妻两个没一个用双剑的。
小时候堂姐就经常带他来欲宗让人教，东学学、西用用，看到那个攻击方式好看就学那个，结果学的乱七八糟的。”
“师尊我跟你说不出两招小白后腰绝对被踹。”
话音刚落，场中的柳清漪果然抓住欧阳叙白右肩抬高的瞬间，一个侧身避开剑锋，剑尖直点他右肩要穴！
欧阳叙白侧身闪避，柳清晏出现在他身后，一脚踹上他的后腰，欧阳叙白痛呼一声，双剑差点脱手。
“你们兄妹俩不讲武德！”
赵归涯臭屁地冲楚安芷眨眨眼：“看吧～”
楚安芷惊讶地看着自家徒弟：“你连这都看得出来？”
“还好吧。”
赵归涯撇了撇嘴又恢复了那副懒散模样，重新靠回树干上，“小时候在欲宗除了帮忙批改文件和做做生意，就是被各门的长老弟子拉去陪练或观战，久了自然就会了。”
楚安芷惊讶：“你小时候那么辛苦？”
赵归涯苦笑：“不辛苦，命苦。”
content_en:
At the back mountain training ground, seven members of Guan Shizong gathered together.
"You should first understand each other's expertise."
Ye Zhiqiu, as the leader of the sect, presided over the ceremony, "You should show your common moves first, and your master and I will take a look."
"Yes!"
On the back mountain training ground, four figures shuttled and intertwined like swimming dragons. The sword light flashed and the sound of gold and stone clashing could be heard endlessly.
"Xiao Yan, the left wing is three points too late!"
Feng Wuhen stood on the sidelines with his hands behind his back, staring sharply at the four swordsmen in the field, "Xiaobai, your moves are too fancy. Believe it or not, you were kicked off the stage by your opponent before you even made a move!"
As soon as the words were spoken, just listen.
"Bang!"
Ouyang Xubai was knocked away by Liu Qingyan's sword, and he rolled on the ground twice before he stopped.
He got up in disgrace and said with a sad face: "Brother Yan, you are too cruel!"
Liu Qingyan put away his sword and stood up, expressionless: "Don't you think about how embarrassing it would be for you, a person in the early stage of the Golden Elixir, to be knocked away by me, a person with the Foundation Establishment Perfection."
"That's right,"
Liu Qingyi was gloating at the side, "Xiao Bai, those swords you just used were like butterflies, but it's a pity that they are useless~"
Chu Anzhi stood on the sidelines, watching the disciples compete with each other, and smiled unconsciously.
She turned to look at Zhao Guiya, who had been practicing for a while beside her and said that she had not had a good rest all night. She ran over to avoid him. Her smile fell and she said, "Look at him, then look at you."
Zhao Guiya was leaning on a tree trunk and eating melon seeds. Hearing this, he stretched lazily and said, "Master, I haven't recovered from my spiritual overdraft yesterday. I told you that I don't want to fight with their natal swords with my basic sword."
Chu Anzhi was about to reprimand this lazy apprentice when she suddenly discovered that although Zhao Guiya said he didn't practice, his amber eyes were always watching the movements of everyone in the field, nodding or shaking his head slightly from time to time.
"You do take it seriously."
Chu Anzhi raised her eyebrows.
Zhao Guiya swallowed the melon seeds and said lazily: "Master, what do you think of Xiaobai's swordsmanship?"
After hearing this, Chu Anzhi looked at the field again.
Ouyang Xubai was sparring with Liu Qingyi at this time, dancing with his swords in an airtight manner, which was indeed very gorgeous.
“More than fancy, not enough practicality.”
Chu Anzhi commented.
"It's more than that."
Zhao Guiya suddenly stood up straight and tapped his fingers, "You see, his right shoulder unconsciously raises three points every time before he draws his sword. Neither my cousin nor his wife use double swords.
When he was a child, his cousin often brought him to the Yu Sect to teach him, learning from the east and the west. If he saw an attack method that looked good, he would learn that one, but he ended up learning it in a mess. "
"Master, I can't tell you two moves that Xiaobai will definitely get kicked in the back."
As soon as he finished speaking, Liu Qingyi in the field caught the moment when Ouyang Xubai raised his right shoulder, turned sideways to avoid the edge of the sword, and pointed the tip of the sword straight at the key point on his right shoulder!
Ouyang Xubai dodged sideways, but Liu Qingyan appeared behind him and kicked him on the lower back. Ouyang Xubai screamed in pain and almost let go of his swords.
"You two brothers and sisters don't have martial ethics!"
Zhao Guiya winked at Chu Anzhi: "Let's see~"
Chu Anzhi looked at her apprentice in surprise: "You can even see this?"
"It's okay."
Zhao Guiya curled his lips and returned to his lazy look, leaning back on the tree trunk again, "When I was a child, in the Yu Sect, apart from helping to correct documents and do business, I was also dragged by the elders and disciples of various sects to practice or watch battles. After a long time, I will naturally become good at it."
Chu Anzhi was surprised: "Did you work so hard when you were a child?"
Zhao Guiya smiled bitterly: "It's not hard work, but life is hard."
